summary: DoRaa Sangam House - Premium e-commerce website with Vastrado-style layout, featuring centered logo, horizontal category navigation, product grid, user dashboard with theme switcher (Dark/Light/System), and Internet Identity authentication
architectural_notes: Dark luxury theme (#0B0E0C bg, white text) as default with Light theme option (#F8F9FA bg, #1A1A1A text)
localStorage used for theme persistence across sessions
System theme mode follows OS preference using prefers-color-scheme media query
Golden hover effects (#FFD700) and glow animations on interactive elements
16px curved corners on product cards with subtle shadows and hover lift effects
Cyan/teal buttons for category navigation with hover glow
Internet Identity authentication system with login/OTP flow
Protected routes requiring authentication for dashboard and cart actions
Mock product data with placeholder images for initial deployment

existing_features.title: Transform the home page post-login layout to display a large centered DoRaa Sangam House logo in elegant gold font on dark background at the top center of the page

Add a horizontal category navigation bar below the logo with five categories: Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All. Style buttons with cyan/teal colors and golden hover glow effects. Make the navigation horizontally scrollable on mobile devices.

Display a grid of product cards below the navigation showing saree products with on-model images, product name, price, discount percentage badge, and Add to Cart button. Cards should have 16px curved corners, subtle shadows, and on hover display lift animation with golden border glow.
Add an optional hero banner section at the top of the product grid with full-width saree showcase image and overlay text reading 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'

Create a user dashboard page accessible via the profile icon with three tabs: Profile, Orders, and Addresses. Display user profile information including name, email, and phone number with a save button to update the data.

Add a Theme Switcher section in the user dashboard with three theme options: Dark (current #0B0E0C background with white text), Light (white/light gray #F8F9FA background with dark #1A1A1A text), and System (follows OS prefers-color-scheme). Save the user's theme choice in localStorage and apply it on page load.
Ensure the light theme maintains clean readability with proper contrast ratios for all text, buttons, and interactive elements while preserving the premium luxury aesthetic
Apply golden hover glow effects consistently across all buttons, icons, and interactive elements in both dark and light themes
Ensure the entire interface is fully responsive: on mobile devices, categories scroll horizontally, logo remains centered, and product grid adjusts to single or two-column layout
Require user authentication to access the dashboard and perform cart actions. Display a login prompt or redirect to login page when unauthenticated users attempt to access protected features.
Preserve all existing functionality including Internet Identity authentication, OTP login flows, shopping cart operations, and category carousel features without introducing regressions or bugs
Generate five generated product images showing sarees on models for use in the product grid, each with dimensions 800x1000 pixels and visually distinct styles

Internet Identity authentication with login/OTP flow, login required for dashboard and cart
Hero banner with 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off' text overlay
Responsive design with horizontal scrolling categories and centered logo on mobile
Add a user profile/dashboard icon (circle avatar or icon) in the top right corner of the navigation bar that opens the user dashboard when clicked
